question: What topics are to be explained in detail in the thirty-first and thirty-second chapters?
premises: Certain matters are to be explained in detail in the thirty-first chapter.
The distinctions of quality and principality are topics of the thirty-second chapter.
The own nature and the worship of power are topics of the thirty-second chapter.
inference: The thirty-first chapter gives a detailed treatment, and the thirty-second chapter addresses distinctions of quality and principality, own nature, and the worship of power.
uncertainties: The verse compresses the transition between chapters, so the exact boundary of topics is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: These matters are to be explained in detail in the thirty-first chapter. In the thirty-second chapter, the distinctions of quality and principality, the own nature, and the worship of power are set forth.
